newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Sept industry output up vs 95, down vs Aug.
newsitem.headline: Chile Sept industry output up vs 95, down vs Aug.

text.p: Chilean industrial production grew 2.2 percent in September against the same month last year, with sales increasing one percent in the same period, said industrial lobby Sofofa.
Sofofa's figures showed industrial production last month down 8.6 percent from August, with sales off 5.2 percent.
The September figures bring the increase in industrial output to two percent in the first nine months of the year, while sales grew 2.4 percent.
